title: The spectrum of the signal
caption: The signal is a sum of two sine waves, so its spectrum has two spikes: 50 Hz with amplitude 3 and 120 Hz with amplitude 1. The first is three times as tall.
alt: A spectrum with two spikes: a tall one of height 3 at 50 hertz and a short one of height 1 at 120 hertz.
description: Each sine wave gives one spike in the spectrum, at its frequency.
The 50 Hz spike has height 3 and the 120 Hz spike height 1: three times smaller.
